observed.caption: An overhead view looking down into a multi-level concrete stairwell with a central red carpet runner and zigzagging staircases on both sides.
observed.description: The photo shows the interior of a multi-story building viewed from above, looking down into an open atrium. A straight red carpet runs down the center of the main walkway and continues onto stair treads on lower levels. On both sides of the central walkway are angular concrete staircases with textured gray balustrades and dark metal handrails that zigzag between floors. A concrete bridge spans across the middle of the frame, connecting upper walkways. The floors show a mix of red carpet, greenish terrazzo, and reddish-brown brick-patterned tile. A small rectangular sign is mounted on the face of the central bridge. The lighting is even and diffused, and no people are visible.
